packageRules.description: Digest pinning is the decision in docs/decisions/image-digest-pinning.md: every third-party base image carries its readable tag PLUS an @sha256 digest, so the tag stays legible in the file while the bits are fixed. Renovate is the only thing that moves either — it re-resolves the digest when it bumps a tag, and opens a digest-only PR when the tag has not moved but the registry serves new bits. tests/test_image_pins.sh fails on a floating reference, so a hand edit that drops a digest cannot merge.

Our own images (ghcr.io/champyod/*, incl. cms-docker-* and cms-security-scan) are built by this repo's CI and selected at deploy time by ${IMG_TAG}. A digest would freeze the stack to one build, so pinning them is wrong by design and Renovate must not propose it — the same reason tests/test_image_pins.sh exempts them.
One PR per week for every compose base image: they are read together when the stack is upgraded, and eleven separate PRs is how the stack drifts half-updated
Dockerfile base images move together with the compose ones they must match
Actions are pinned by tag in .github/workflows; one PR keeps the CI change reviewable
The panel ships from bun.lock in one directory; grouped so a bump is tested against the suite once
Python constraints are pinned by constraints.txt; minor and patch land together
Rust lockfiles in ranking-web and tools/cms-tui
